origin: LTspice schematics by the maintainer, LTspice 26.1.1's -netlist exports of them, and variants of the exports made for M14, each changing one form
author: xdylanm
notes: Exported by LTspice 26.1.1 with -netlist; the first comment line holds the absolute schematic path in the export and is replaced by the file name. A variant's second line says what it changes. The intentional failures are in elements_rejects. Provenance confirmed by the maintainer, 2026-11-06.

.gitignore.note: Keeps LTspice run output out, as in ltspice_transistors (decision 0009).

lt_test_esource.asc.note: E: a VCVS of gain 2.2 (schematic by the maintainer).

lt_test_fsource.asc.note: F: a CCCS sensing V1 (schematic by the maintainer).

lt_test_fsource_ctrl_e.cir.note: Variant: the controlling source is an E; loads with CONTROL_SOURCE_MISMATCH, and LTspice runs it.

lt_test_gsource.asc.note: G: a VCCS between two dividers (schematic by the maintainer).

lt_test_gsource_formula.cir.note: Variant: the transconductance is a formula.

lt_test_hsource.asc.note: H: a CCVS sensing V1 (schematic by the maintainer).

lt_test_hsource_ctrl_into_instance.cir.note: Variant: the controlling source is X1:Vq, inside an instance; LTspice runs it, and the library reports UNRESOLVED_ELEMENT as info.

lt_test_iswitch.asc.note: W: a CSW switch (schematic by the maintainer).

lt_test_iswitch_off.cir.note: Variant: the initial state is off.

lt_test_vswitch.asc.note: S: an SW switch with off (schematic by the maintainer).

lt_test_vswitch_off_value.cir.note: Variant: off=1, a flag with a value.

lt_test_vswitch_on.cir.note: Variant: the initial state is on.
